definition.description_en: The FnF state machine definition of the workflow in YAML format
definition.description_zh: 工作流的FnF State Machine定义（YAML格式）
definition.example:
Type: StateMachine
Name: agent-flow-pSioD
SpecVersion: v1
States:
  - Name: 开始
    Type: Pass
    GlobalConstructor:
      sys.query.$: '$Input["sys.query"]'
      sys.conversation_id.$: '$Input["sys.conversation_id"]'
      sys.user_id.$: '$Input["sys.user_id"]'
    Annotations:
      id: '1776240594140'
      title: 开始
    OutputConstructor:
      sys.query.$: '$Input["sys.query"]'
      sys.conversation_id.$: '$Input["sys.conversation_id"]'
      sys.user_id.$: '$Input["sys.user_id"]'
    Next: 结束
  - Type: Succeed
    Name: 结束
    Annotations:
      id: 1776240594140-end
      title: 结束
    End: true
StartAt: 开始
definition.title: 定义
